Nib Accounts

Saving Account

Savings account is an interest bearing deposit. Individuals, organizations and associations can maintain saving accounts as long as they are legal and meet the procedural requirements set by the Bank. The account is opened with the minimum initial deposit of only Birr 50.00.

Nib Kefo

No matter what your business is, whatever you do, you can save even fraction of cents every day but you don’t need to come to our bank. We are coming to your home with our innovative saving service known as Nib kefo Saving.

Lucy Saving

Lucy deposit account is women saving account established to encourage women to save and earn higher interest rate. Any women can open lucy saving account with an initial deposit amount not less than Birr 50.

Deposit Products

Shari'ah-compliant Mudarabah and Wadi'ah savings accounts designed to fit every customer: individuals, women, children, students, businesses, Equb and Edir groups, and more.

Financing Products

Murabahah-based financing solutions: term financing, revolving facilities, import LC, and pre/post-shipment export financing structured entirely free of interest.

Contracts

A Kafala (Bank Guarantee) issued by the Bank is a formal commitment to compensate the beneficiary, whether local or foreign, if the applicant fails to fulfill the obligations specified in the guarantee contract. The guarantee is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable guarantee agreement.

Remittance

Remittance refers to the act of transferring or sending certain amount of money by one party to the other.

Loan Calculator Help...

Using the calculator is straight forward. User enters a "loan amount", "number of months", "annual interest rate". The calculator calculates the number of monthly payments.

The "Payment Method" determines when the first payment is due. With the default selection, "End-of-Period", the first payment will be due one month after the loan is made. If "Start-of-Period" is selected, then the first payment will be due on the loan date.

The term (duration) of the loan is expressed as a number of months.

  •  60 months =  5 years
  • 120 months = 10 years
  • 180 months = 15 years
  • 240 months = 20 years
  • 360 months = 30 years

Need more options including the ability to solve for other unknowns, change payment / compounding frequency and the ability to print an amortization schedule? Please visit, https://AccurateCalculators.com/loan-calculator

Currency and Date Conventions

All calculators will remember your choice. You may also change it at any time.

Clicking "Save changes" will cause the calculator to reload. Your edits will be lost.
